query: SELECT f.id, f.name, s.key AS "key?", s.value AS "value?" FROM facilities f LEFT JOIN scoped_settings s ON s.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND s.scope = 'facility' AND s.scope_id = f.id AND s.category = 'locale' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.tenant_id = $1 AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.name, f.id LIMIT 2000
